'''Cortheum''' was the rocky form of the gas [[Corthel]]. A valuable mineral, Cortheum was used in the manufacture of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. Veins of Cortheum were discovered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nurstin]] in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]]. Settlers on the planet [[Draenell's Point]] in the same [[Star system/Legends|star system]] sent expeditions to investigate strange flashes of light emanating from Nurstin's surface. Upon investigation, they discovered the light flashes were the result of high concentrations of Corthel in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and large amounts of Cortheum were buried [[Meter/Legends|meters]] below the surface. Miners began to excavate the mineral, until [[Messert Mines Corporation]] received an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] charter and exclusive mineral rights to Nurstin.<ref name="GK" />
